provenance.scope: Species 1–493 (the ones PokeSwap uses today) and every Gen VI form of them.

sources.role: tabular data (species, stats, types, moves, learnsets, abilities, natures, type chart)

Generation VI correction layer and semantic reference. The tabular source ships present-day base stats and ability slots; this pinned mod is the recorded diff back to Gen VI, and the build applies its baseStats/abilities overrides. Move behaviour is still only read by humans: no effect code is copied.
cross-check only, never at runtime and never in this pipeline.
